issuer_context.operating_entity: HarborFlow Labs, a fictional devnet test entity
issuer_context.product_summary: HarborFlow is a fictional Solana-native treasury automation protocol used to exercise Yieldia's offering lifecycle on devnet.
issuer_context.wallet_control_explanation: The HarborFlow devnet authority controls the onchain Issuer and its canonical YTUSD associated token account used as the offering treasury.

economic_claim.instrument_right: Each instrument token carries an equal pro-rata claim on the YTUSD actually funded into this offering's Yield vault.
economic_claim.economic_formula: The target funding is 110,000,000 YTUSD base units for 100 instrument tokens; the program pays floor(funded base units / 100) per redeemed token when a holder redeems their full balance.
economic_claim.revenue_basis: Synthetic test YTUSD allocated to HarborFlow by the Yieldia devnet operator; no real-world revenue is represented.
economic_claim.credibility_explanation: The Yieldia devnet operator controls the YTUSD mint and can allocate the test balance needed to fund the deterministic proof.
economic_claim.expected_source_of_funds: Devnet YTUSD transferred by the Yieldia operator to the HarborFlow authority, plus the YTUSD received from the primary sale.
economic_claim.source_plausibility: The operator minted 1,000,000,000 YTUSD for devnet testing, while this proof targets only 110 YTUSD of Yield funding.
dependencies: Two controlled buyers purchase all 100 instrument units.
The operator supplies enough test YTUSD for HarborFlow to fund 110 YTUSD into the Yield vault.

onchain_references.label: prospectus
onchain_references.role: prospectus PDA derived from the issuer and prospectus ID hash

evidence.operating_evidence_summary: The fixture provides deterministic issuer, author, mint, treasury, and prospectus addresses for an inspectable devnet lifecycle; it provides no evidence of real operations or revenue.

supporting_documents.label: ytusd-explorer
supporting_documents.description: Solana Explorer view of the YTUSD devnet mint.

evidence.interpretation_notes: All balances and transactions are devnet-only. Addresses are real devnet references, while the issuer narrative and economic activity are synthetic test data.

operational: Solana devnet may be reset, unavailable, congested, or rate-limited.
A controlled wallet may fail to complete its assigned lifecycle action.
financial: The stated payout is a test target, not an enforceable offchain obligation.
vault_funding_risks: The operator may not transfer sufficient YTUSD to HarborFlow.
HarborFlow may not submit the Yield-funding transaction.
market_failure_risks: The primary sale fails unless all 100 units are purchased before the slot deadline.
The sold-out offering becomes refundable if settlement is delayed beyond the approved windows.

market_readiness.tradeable_market_rationale: Transferable classic SPL tokens make the successful lifecycle observable across controlled devnet wallets, but this fixture does not claim real liquidity or price discovery.
market_support_sources: Solana Explorer account and transaction views.
The hosted Yieldia proof dashboard once connected to devnet.
monitorable_signals: Buyer receipts, instrument balances, and lifecycle transaction signatures.
market_readiness.participation_restrictions: Only controlled devnet wallets should participate; the fixture is not offered on mainnet.
market_readiness.transfer_restrictions: No instrument tokens exist before successful settlement and allocation claims. Once minted, the current classic SPL instrument has no program-enforced transfer restriction; after offering close, unredeemed tokens are inert even if they remain transferable.
market_readiness.crowdfunding_difference: The proof binds fixed issuance, price, assets, treasury, windows, evidence, settlement, and redemption to one hash-addressed prospectus and an inspectable onchain lifecycle.
